<documents>
<document id="account-contact-change">
ChangingˆyourˆemailˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆYouˆcanˆchangeˆyourˆemailˆaddressˆandˆphoneˆnumberˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPersonalˆdetails.ˆ##ˆEmailˆEnterˆtheˆnewˆemail.ˆWeˆsendˆaˆconfirmationˆlinkˆtoˆtheˆnewˆaddressˆandˆaˆnoticeˆtoˆtheˆoldˆone.ˆTheˆchangeˆhappensˆwhenˆyouˆtapˆtheˆlink.ˆ##ˆPhoneˆnumberˆEnterˆtheˆnewˆnumberˆandˆconfirmˆtheˆcodeˆweˆtextˆtoˆit.ˆYou'llˆalsoˆbeˆaskedˆtoˆapproveˆtheˆchangeˆfromˆyourˆcurrentˆdevice.ˆ##ˆLostˆaccessˆtoˆyourˆoldˆphoneˆorˆemailˆMessageˆsupport.ˆBecauseˆthisˆisˆaˆcommonˆwayˆforˆfraudstersˆtoˆtakeˆoverˆaccounts,ˆweˆpassˆtheseˆrequestsˆtoˆourˆVerificationˆteam,ˆwhoˆmayˆaskˆforˆaˆnewˆselfie.ˆ##ˆAfterˆaˆchangeˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆaˆchange,ˆifˆyou'reˆalsoˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆlimitedˆtoˆ$500.ˆIfˆyouˆgetˆaˆnoticeˆaboutˆaˆchangeˆyouˆdidn'tˆmake,ˆmessageˆusˆrightˆaway.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-two-step">
Two-stepˆverificationˆTwo-stepˆverificationˆisˆalwaysˆonˆforˆTallowbrookˆaccounts.ˆWhenˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆorˆdoˆsomethingˆsensitive,ˆweˆaskˆforˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆaˆsecondˆstep.ˆ##ˆTheˆsecondˆstepˆ-ˆAˆpushˆapprovalˆonˆaˆdeviceˆyou'veˆalreadyˆsignedˆinˆon,ˆorˆ-ˆAˆone-timeˆcodeˆsentˆbyˆtext,ˆvalidˆforˆ10ˆminutesˆ##ˆWhenˆweˆaskˆ-ˆSigningˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdeviceˆ-ˆChangingˆyourˆpassword,ˆemailˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆ-ˆAddingˆaˆnewˆexternalˆaccountˆorˆwireˆrecipientˆ-ˆViewingˆyourˆfullˆvirtualˆcardˆnumberˆ##ˆKeepˆcodesˆtoˆyourselfˆAˆone-timeˆcodeˆisˆonlyˆforˆyouˆtoˆtypeˆintoˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp.ˆNobodyˆfromˆTallowbrookˆwillˆaskˆyouˆtoˆreadˆitˆout.ˆIfˆsomeoneˆasks,ˆit'sˆaˆscam.ˆ##ˆChangedˆyourˆphoneˆnumber?ˆUpdateˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆwhileˆyouˆstillˆhaveˆtheˆoldˆnumber.ˆIfˆyou'veˆlostˆaccessˆtoˆyourˆoldˆnumber,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWe'llˆpassˆitˆtoˆtheˆteamˆthatˆverifiesˆidentity,ˆwhichˆcanˆtakeˆlonger.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="security-never-ask">
Whatˆwe'llˆneverˆaskˆyouˆScammersˆoftenˆpretendˆtoˆbeˆfromˆaˆbank.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆTallowbrookˆwillˆneverˆaskˆyouˆfor,ˆbyˆphone,ˆtext,ˆemail,ˆchatˆorˆsocialˆmedia.ˆ##ˆWeˆwillˆneverˆaskˆforˆ-ˆYourˆfullˆcardˆnumberˆorˆsecurityˆcodeˆ-ˆYourˆPINˆ-ˆYourˆpasswordˆorˆpasscodeˆ-ˆAˆone-timeˆcodeˆweˆsentˆyouˆ-ˆRemoteˆaccessˆtoˆyourˆphoneˆorˆcomputerˆ-ˆToˆmoveˆyourˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆ"safeˆaccount"ˆtoˆprotectˆitˆ-ˆToˆbuyˆgiftˆcardsˆorˆsendˆcryptocurrencyˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆmightˆaskˆInˆtheˆapp,ˆsupportˆmayˆaskˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆrecentˆtransactionsˆorˆyourˆaddress.ˆThat'sˆinˆyourˆsigned-inˆsession,ˆwhereˆweˆalreadyˆknowˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆIfˆsomeoneˆasksˆStop,ˆhangˆupˆorˆcloseˆtheˆchat.ˆOpenˆtheˆTallowbrookˆappˆyourselfˆandˆmessageˆus.ˆDon'tˆcallˆaˆnumberˆorˆtapˆaˆlinkˆtheˆpersonˆgaveˆyou.ˆOurˆrealˆphoneˆnumberˆisˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆHelp.ˆIfˆyouˆalreadyˆsharedˆaˆcodeˆorˆpassword,ˆchangeˆyourˆpasswordˆrightˆawayˆandˆmessageˆusˆsoˆweˆcanˆsecureˆyourˆaccount.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
